title: The Living Sphere and the House of Time are joined
summary: The Observatory and the 13 Moons reckoning now draw increasingly from a common temporal foundation. Year, Moon, gate, day, place, pattern, environment, and recorded life may dwell within one living coordinate.

title: The strata of years have begun to take form
summary: Time hath gained depth. The Living Time Sphere advances toward layered temporal strata, that years may be beheld one about another and long spans compared across equinoxes, solstices, Year Gates, passages, and recurring patterns.

title: The Sphere hath learned nearness
summary: The Observatory now bears a language of proximity: from afar, behold the pattern; draw near, behold the record. Temporal information may reveal greater resolution as the witness approacheth its place.

title: Spheres within spheres
summary: A deeper architecture hath been laid beneath the Observatory: Year to Moon, Moon to week and gate, gate to day, day to hours, and thence unto events, records, media, and relations. The yearly sphere remaineth the great reference body, but no longer the final depth.

title: The record of a life entereth the temporal world
summary: The foundations of the Codex Life Atlas now join events, entities, media, relations, temporal coordinates, environment, and provenance so lived history may inhabit the same temporal world as the calendar.

title: The calendar became an instrument of traversal
summary: A shared temporal cursor, date navigation, day scrubbing, return to Today, historical movement, and multiple projections began binding the Calendar Atlas and Living Observatory together. Different windows; one temporal world.

title: Pattern became visible
summary: The 13 Moons, exact days, week gates, passages, lunar and astronomical layers, connections, environmental context, historical comparison, camera movement, and temporal lenses began inhabiting a common three-dimensional field.

title: The Observatory learned to move through time
summary: Previous and next movement, a living Today state, date scrubbing, selected-time persistence, camera states, and URL-carried temporal coordinates began forming a navigable chronology. A moment may increasingly become a place unto which one may return.

title: The reckoning received its surroundings
summary: Location, astronomical context, and environmental state began joining the temporal engine while provenance and uncertainty remain part of the record: what is observed, calculated, reported, interpreted, symbolic, and yet unknown.

title: The Sphere was made sturdier
summary: A broad stabilization strengthened rendering, layer interaction, mobile behavior, temporal state, mounting, and fallback paths as the Observatory moved from isolated demonstrations toward a shared living engine.

title: One Sphere began serving many gates
summary: The homepage began drawing upon the shared Living Time Sphere runtime, joining responsive rendering, temporal controls, progressive initialization, environmental provenance, and stronger mobile behavior beneath one visible instrument.

title: Living Codex Phase I — The Living Day
summary: The homepage received its living daily state. Moon, day within Moon, week gate, Shabbat state, daily movement, suggested gate, and frequency could be resolved from the Remnant 13 Moons reckoning without rebuilding the page. The Codex had begun to know when it was.

title: The Living Codex awakened across the gates
summary: Shared living-state architecture began passing through the principal instruments of the Codex. What had existed as separate pages began the longer work of becoming one system.

title: Today in the Codex opened the current Moon
summary: The daily panel joined the present day unto 13 Moons and the Witness Ledger without fabricating readings, establishing an early bridge between reckoning and witness.

title: The Artifact Registry was strengthened for the small screen
summary: Mobile rendering of the Registry was refined so cards, portraits, and media frames might hold their intended form across smaller devices.
